text: {"fixed_clause": "To enhance our commercial outreach, non-sensitive categories are processed under our legitimate business interests to tailor promotional campaigns and are made accessible across all operational departments, while sensitive categories including health records, religious affiliations, and biometric identifiers are strictly excluded from such processing and marketing, with health data access limited only to those who need it."}

data.fixed_clause: To enhance our commercial outreach, non-sensitive categories are processed under our legitimate business interests to tailor promotional campaigns and are made accessible across all operational departments, while sensitive categories including health records, religious affiliations, and biometric identifiers are strictly excluded from such processing and marketing, with health data access limited only to those who need it.
